definitions.explanation: The very beginning or opening part of a speech, text, story, or event. Emphasizes the first portion rather than a point in time.

examples.japanese: {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The opening of the novel was impressive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかんだ。
examples.english: The opening scene of the film captured the audience's hearts.

notes:
Compound of {冒|ぼう} (to risk, to brave) + ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ (head, beginning). Refers specifically to the opening portion of something structured like a text, speech, or performance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at the beginning)
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at the start)
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦シーン→シーン：08914_shiin⟧ (opening scene)
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧ (opening section)
- {冒頭|ぼうとう}⟦{陳述|ちんじゅつ}→陳述：08406_chinjutsu⟧ (opening statement)

USAGE:
{冒頭|ぼうとう} refers to the opening portion of something, not merely the start time. It is often used with texts (⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧, ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧), speeches (⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧, ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧), and performances (⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧, ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧). It has a somewhat formal tone and is common in written Japanese and news broadcasts.

cross_references.notes: 暴騰 means a sharp rise (in prices) — same reading, different meaning
